messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.
message.reasoning: The user asks "What is the current time in New York City?" We have no function for time. We can answer with approximate or we can say we don't know. But we can compute using known timezone offset. But we don't have real-time data. We can approximate based on UTC offset. But we can't guarantee accuracy. We could respond that we don't have real-time capability. According to policy, we should not provide inaccurate info. So we should say we cannot provide real-time.
